title: anacyclus monanthos subsp. cyrtolepidioides
intro: Anacyclus monanthos subsp. cyrtolepidioides, commonly known as Moroccan chamomile, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including insomnia, anxiety, and digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, spasmolytic, and sedative effects, which contribute to its calming and soothing properties. The bioactive constituents of Anacyclus monanthos subsp. cyrtolepidioides include essential oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
